title: Gossip
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office is rife with rumors and gossip, sparked by Michael's eagerness to be part of the social scene. Michael, Dwight, and Andy engage in playful antics like Parkour, while gossip about relationships and personal lives spreads rapidly. Michael spreads a rumor about Stanley having an affair, which Stanley admits to, causing tension. Andy confronts rumors about his sexuality, leading to confusion and discussions with Jim. Ultimately, Michael admits to fabricating most rumors, revealing that the only true secret is Pam's pregnancy, confirmed by a sonogram. The episode explores the impact of gossip on relationships and office dynamics, ending with unresolved questions about the consequences of the rumors.

main_threads.thread: The spread and impact of gossip and rumors in the office, including Michael's role in fabricating and spreading them, and the resulting tensions and confessions.

evidence.snippet: Michael (entEring break room, to Maurie): You stupid son of a bitch. You set me up.
Michael (in parking lot, blocking path of Stanley's car): Stop. Hold up, hold up, hold up! No, no, no. Time to stop being polite and get real. Stanley, are you having an affair?
Stanley: And it's been lonely.
Stanley: Cynthia's been keeping me company. She was my nurse, when I was in rehabilitation.
Michael: How do you un-tell something? You can't. You can't put words back in your mouth.
Michael (to everyone, in conference room): Okay, I made it all up.

main_threads.thread: Andy grapples with rumors about his sexuality, discussing his feelings and confusion with Oscar and Jim.

evidence.snippet: Andy: This is not the first time rumors about me being gay have come up.

Oscar: Wow. I wish… I wish I could help you. I don't… you might be gay. You might be gay.
